# Ordinarybook: what it can do, and how it got here

An empty placeholder repository for a future book called Ordinary Book; so far it holds only a placeholder file and the standard household agent files.

## How we got here

Every change entry, newest first: what it was for, and what it made possible.

### 20261028-change-record-in-ordinarybook

Task `change-record-deploy-repos-20261028`.

**Why.** Ordinarybook had no record of why its code changes: a commit message keeps what changed, not why it mattered, and the reason lived only in the memory of whoever made it. Ken asked on 2026-10-27 for the household change record in every repository, tuned to each.

**Enables.** Every commit here that changes the agent files and the admin folder now carries why it mattered and what it enables, judged when it is made, while changes to the placeholder for the book alone need no entry.

**Untested:** This commit installs the gate here; the engine and this repository's tuning are tested in Project-Sophos, in admin/tests/change-record.test.mjs and admin/tests/change-record-deploy.test.mjs.
